text:
zain: heads-up: post-deploy smoke against streaming chat route in eu-central1 shows intermittent 503s on short conversations. baseline 0.1% -> observed ~3% over last 10m. rollout at 55%.

deploy-bot: Deploy summary: release-2026-03-24 started 2026-03-24T09:40Z. Targets: api-prod. Progress: 55%. Canary checks: PASS. Post-deploy synth: WARNING. Link: https://deploy/release-2026-03-24

mira: I see proxy 503s with upstream=runtime-unavailable on eu-central1 hosts. not seeing CPU spikes. possible runtime under-provisioning during warm traffic ramp (new scaling policy in this release).

ops-bot: Mitigation options:
- reduce rollout to canary or pause
- pin /v1/chat-stream in eu-central1 to streaming-1.0-stable
- temporarily increase instance count or lower min-scale smoothing window
- roll back scaling policy change (last resort)

pav: before we change infra, can we run a targeted smoke (500 samples) and restart a couple runtime nodes to clear transient errors? if runtime warmup lags, restart might help.

zain: holding rollout at 55%. initiating restart of 2 runtime instances in eu-central1 and starting targeted smoke. command: 
```
redwoodctl host restart --region eu-central1 --service runtime --count 2 --reason "postdeploy 503s"
redwoodctl smoke run --region eu-central1 --route /v1/chat-stream --samples 500 --type postdeploy-synth
```

deploy-bot: Action: rollout hold at 55% recorded by zain. Host restart triggered. Smoke job scheduled.

health-bot: smoke job started: id=smoke-1865432100-stream region=eu-central1 samples=500 type=postdeploy-synth

mira: restarted runtime instances eu-central1-{4,7}. watching host logs for warmup errors `runtime warmup delay` and `upstream runtime-unavailable`.

health-bot: smoke job update: 200/500 sampled -> 503s fell from 3% -> 0.5%. continuing.

pav: good signal. keep pinned? my preference: don't pin model, instead keep rollout paused and observe for 20m; if stable, resume to 80%. pinning hides infra regression.

zain: agree. pause and observe. adding release-note snippet for transparency: "release-2026-03-24: regional hold in eu-central1 due to post-deploy 503s on streaming chat. Host restarts performed; monitoring. No model pin or rollback."

health-bot: smoke job complete: id=smoke-1865432100-stream results: 500 sampled, 3/500 503 (0.6%), p95=180ms, notes="errors reduced after runtime restarts; no model variant change"

mira: will open infra ticket to review scaling policy smoothing window and warmup behavior. if we confirm warmup lag, propose adding a preflight scaling check in canary job to validate instance readiness before traffic increase.

zain: holding for 20m observation window. if 503s < 1% for 15m, resume to 80% then full after additional verification. tagging infra: @mira @pav for RCA.

deploy-bot: Hold recorded: 20m observation window. Auto-action: resume -> 80% if no alerts during window.
